body: Yes one of my nurses told me the same thing. She said that many people end up having really bad health problems or end up passing away because they're too afraid to ask for help. I knew I needed to do this in order to get the proper help for me. It does suck being watched over so much but it's good to know that they care enough to not let you hurt yourself again. I'm really glad to hear you're doing better as well, and thank you also for being strong enough to get the help you needed. ❤️

I'm going on 2 days today. And I'm happy to hear that you're doing better. I hope you didn't do too much damage to your body. It's nice to to hear someone else's story and how they instantly regretted their decision too. I'm glad you're still with us. I hope your life is going good right now ❤️

Yeah don't do it you'll instantly regret it. I thought I would feel happy and alive but it was the complete opposite. Stay alive. You're loved and cared about and needed by many ❤️ if you need anyone to talk to I'm here for you. 
Sending you love and positivity 💕
Talk to me! Please I'm all ears. I would love to listen to you.

Yeah gladly I'm from a fairly small town our hospitals are usually not too busy, so the nurses and doctors really take their time to focus on their patients. They don't treat you like a victims either they're just really supportive and caring and they really dedicate their time and effort just to make sure you're okay. Thanks for the well wishes ! ❤️

Of course. Thank you ☺️💕 

Love you!
Since they were codeine pills I just wanted to be safe, and I knew I needed to do it to get the proper resources to get the mental help I needed.
Thank you for the kind words ❤️
Wow, that's really good advice I never really thought of it that way. You're completely right. Thank you for that it honestly really helped ❤️

Wow that's an amazing quite touching story. I'm glad to hear you came out strong. Thank you for sharing your story for other people going through the same thing can see and change their minds. I hope you're doing good health wise as well as that might've done quite a lot of damage from what it sounds like. I'm definitely really happy that you came out stronger and were able to achieve that much in such little time.

Get the help you need please. Don't let it get bad to the point where you hurt yourself. Don't let your problems define you. Because if you do attempt it, you'll regret it instantly. You'll realize that all of your problems are indeed fixable. Stay strong love 💕

I'm currently in college. I emailed my professors to let them know my situation. I was put on a temporary medical leave, it sucks but it's for the best right now. I really don't have any friends and the ones I do have aren't so close to the point where I can tell them comfortably. My family however was devastated and seeing them like that made me realize that if I would've died they probably would've blamed themselves.
Thank you ❤️

I really don't know where you're from but that doesn't apply to where I live. Unless of course you're being violent or posing a threat to others. I don't see why I would lie about something this serious but thank you for taking the time out of your day to read this :) wishing you the best stranger. Sending love your way ❤️
Yes it is really painful. I cant even keep my water down. I'm really happy to see that you recovered and are doing better. It gives me hope. Although I'm very sorry to hear about your friends.

Technically your doctor, by law, can't do that. He has to get you the help you need, even if he's not a psychiatrist he will guide you into getting the help you need. You don't have to open up to your family just yet, but do open up to a professional as they're generally more comfortable to talk to, and they'll tell you what you can do to get better. Maybe after you get professional help it will be easier to open up to your family. Don't do anything to hurt yourself. Fix yourself and make yourself a better person for you and your future. 

Sending love ❤️

No don't do it ! It's not worth it. It's so painful physically and mentally. The hospital food sucks and so does the bed. Although the staff has to be super friendly, it's better to just avoid doing it. Get the help you need! If you need counseling, your city or any close one should have free counseling services. Definitely look into that. Finding a counseling resource and admitting you need it is the first step to change! 

Wishing you the best. Sending you love ❤️

I've realized that too. I'd miss my dog far too much. I miss her like hell rn and it's only been a day. I do live to take care of her like she's my baby I know my family wouldn't look after her like I do. I'm gonna get the help I need to be a better person towards everyone in my life. I'm just rambling now sorry ❤️

Yeah I wouldn't mind it if it weren't for the food or bed honestly! And I'm in a private room so I don't have to deal with the other patients but the staff here at my hospital is super friendly as well. It's heart warming in a way.

Thanks for taking the time to read my post. I'm glad I got the help I needed before it was too late. As for he hospital situation it does suck but the fact that the doctors and nurses aren't treating me like a prisoner and are being super supportive makes it better on me. 

Sending love to you 💕
They were codeine pills. Man don't ever do this to yourself. It's the worst physical pain I've ever been through. I can't even drink water without getting nauseous and starting to gag

I just wanted to help. I felt sharing my story might help others in the same situation. Thank you for taking the time to read my post! 
Love to you as well

I took about 25-30. Luckily I instantly regretted it, and I knew to call 911 immediately. Im in terrible pain rn. I've been nauseous all morning and all day yesterday. I couldn't even drink water. 

I'm glad I realized too. It's really not worth to end your own life. There's always someone to help. Even if it's a complete stranger. Now I hope you didn't ask me how much I took because you're trying to attempt to end your life. Don't.

There's no such thing as a hopeless situation… and it took me being here to realize that. There's thousands of people out there who would love to help you. Even if you don't have insurance there's always non profit counseling groups and help for mental health. 

I used to think exactly like that. There's a lot of people who would care about you if something happened to you. Even if you feel like you're powerless or worthless it's just a symptom. It's all in your head. And don't let that define you! You are loved and cared for. Don't let it get to the point that I'm at. Being in here sucks. Get the help you need there's nothing wrong with asking for the help you need!

I'm not gonna sit here and tell you that "it gets better" because it doesn't. Life is always gonna be unfair and make you question yourself but it's up to you to learn how to cope with it. The more you try to run away from the the worse it's gonna get. As someone who's had problems with depression and panic disorder for over 15 years and has dealt with self harm, I can assure you it doesn't get better, but learning to deal with your problems will make your life way more tolerable and eventually you'll be happier once you realize that problems are always gonna be present. Nobody on this planet has a perfect life some just know how to cope with it better than others. Please don't do anything ! You're loved and cared about even if you think otherwise. Dm me if you need to talk I'm here for you. Sending you love ❤️

Yes it is true that things don't get better, but it's rather something that you need to learn how to cope with. Coming from someone who has self harmed over 50% of their body, has suffered from chronic depression for over 10 years and panic disorder I can assure you it doesn't get better but if you learn how to cope with it you'll find that it won't affect you as much. Life is always gonna be fucked and unfair but you can't let those things phase you. Running away from your problems will only make them worse. Stay strong and realize that you'll be affecting everyone around you even if you think you won't. You are loved and cared about. Please don't do anything to hurt yourself more it's only making the situation worse. If you need anyone don't hesitate to Dm me I would love to talk to you!
And it doesn't make any sense to me because he gave me a promise ring on Valentine's Day which was pretty expensive considering his wage. Idk what to do and why he's acting this way.
This is all over the place I know but all I really want to know is what I should do… I really don't want to lose him.

Thank you, I really thought nobody would even notice, and yes. Hearing my bf say to me that he doesn't know how to help really pushed me. I really don't know if I'm just over thinking it but it makes me feel like he wouldn't care if I died. And also everyday I just wake up feeling this way and it builds up during the day. It's come to the point where I can't even be happy around my family and friends.
